description:
Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) is a maternity benefit program launched by the Government of India. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to pregnant and lactating women. 

The objective is to promote maternal and child health by providing cash incentives. 

Eligible beneficiaries receive a cash benefit of INR 5,000 in three installments. 

This assistance is provided for the first living child of the family. 

Eligibility criteria include being a pregnant woman or lactating mother above 18 years of age. 

The applicant must not be receiving similar benefits under any other scheme. 

The application process involves registering on the PMMVY portal or through Anganwadi centers. 

Beneficiaries must provide necessary documents such as identity proof and bank account details. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development. 

The cash benefits are disbursed directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries. 

The scheme is applicable throughout the country. 

The timeline for receiving benefits is linked to the stages of pregnancy and childbirth. 

The first installment is provided after registration and verification. 

Subsequent installments are provided after the birth of the child and subsequent health check-ups. 

The scheme aims to improve maternal nutrition and health during pregnancy and lactation. 

It also encourages women to seek healthcare services during pregnancy.
